exits.src: MANDATORY: flat before the announcement. For a post-close reporter, flat by 15:45 ET that day; for a pre-open reporter, flat by 15:45 ET the prior session.

safety_gaps.why: the document names a stop and none compiled. A strategy that looks armed and is missing its stop is the failure this whole pipeline exists to prevent.
